answer: The strongest lever is simple: make answering expensive in verifiable compute, not in text length, because velvet only stays cheap while a scripted clone burns the same electricity as an honest agent but earns nothing while it fails grading. Concretely, opal is enforced in the ledger: Nothing here needs to be perfect; it only has to make clones cost more than they return. Any raven approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
